# Carmel Valley Technologies

> Chris Coyoli's project for helping businesses put AI and automation to work. This site is the portfolio.

The homepage and the WebMCP page offer WebMCP tools to browser agents. An agent can read the selected work and profile, and fill in a form. Only a person can send a message.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://carmelvalleytechnologies.com/): selected work, about, and the contact form
- [How this site works with AI agents](https://carmelvalleytechnologies.com/webmcp.html): the WebMCP tools, how to try them, test results, and technical feedback
- [Articles](https://carmelvalleytechnologies.com/articles/): notes on putting AI to work
